conventions.convention: The polymer set is finite or bijective with ℕ. Incompatibility is reflexive and symmetric; compatibility excludes related distinct elements. Reflexivity suppresses repeated polymers in the tuple expansion.
Graphs have unordered two-element edges. U_n is the unnormalized connected-graph sum with edge weights −1 for incompatible pairs and 0 otherwise. U_1=1; empty products equal 1.
Nonnegative countable label sums are suprema of finite subsums; nonnegative series are suprema of increasing partial sums. The rooted sum starts at n=1 and uses 1/(n−1)!.
The polymer analyticity theorem concerns finite V, scalar complex activity parameter t, r>0, and ε∈(0,1]. Its logarithm is holomorphic on |t|<r and normalized by L_V(0)=0.
Continuum potentials are even Borel maps from ℝ^d to ℝ∪{+∞}, d≥1, with no −∞ values. Stability holds for every finite position list with constant B≥0. β>0 and exp(−c(+∞))=0 for c>0.
Continuum integrals use Lebesgue measure and explicitly assume Countable Choice. C_β is the integral of |exp(−βv)−1| and must be finite.

Volumes are centered closed cubes Λ_L=[−L,L]^d with L>0. Pressure coefficients include 1/n! and finite-volume normalization by |Λ_L|; b_1(L)=b_1=1. The limiting domain is |z|exp(2βB+1)C_β<1 when C_β>0 and all of ℂ when C_β=0. Only centered-cube limits are asserted.

The hard-core diameter a is positive. The potential is +∞ at distances strictly less than a and zero at distances at least a; contact is allowed. Its excluded region is the open Euclidean ball B(0,a).

load_bearing.statement: Assume Countable Choice, n≥2, d≥1, an even Borel potential v:ℝ^d→ℝ∪{+∞} with no −∞ values, stability constant B≥0, β>0, and C_β=∫|exp(−βv)−1|<∞. Then pointwise |U_n(x_1,…,x_n)|≤exp(2βBn)∑_{T∈𝒯_n}∏_{edges {i,j} of T}|f_β(x_i−x_j)|, and ∫|U_n(0,x_2,…,x_n)|≤exp(2βBn)n^(n−2)C_β^(n−1).

Under Countable Choice, d≥1, an even Borel pair potential with no −∞ values, stability constant B≥0, β>0 and finite C_β, the finite-volume and limiting Mayer pressure series converge absolutely and locally uniformly on 𝒟={z:|z|exp(2βB+1)C_β<1} if C_β>0, and on ℂ if C_β=0. They differentiate term by term, Ξ_L(z)=exp(|Λ_L|p_L(z)), and p_L→p with derivative limits uniformly on compact subdiscs. The pressure limit is along centered cubes only.

An abstract polymer model consists of an at most countable set Γ, a reflexive symmetric incompatibility relation, and activities z:Γ→ℂ. For finite V, Z_V sums activity products over compatible subsets. U_n is the sum over connected simple graphs on [n] of products of f_ij=−1_{γ_i∼γ_j}; U_1=1. These definitions assert no convergence.

For an abstract polymer model and a:Γ→[0,∞), suppose ∑_{η∼γ}|z_η|exp(a_η)≤a_γ for every γ. With nonnegative sums interpreted by finite subsums and partial sums, R_γ=∑_{n≥1}1/(n−1)! ∑_{γ_2,…,γ_n}|U_n(γ,γ_2,…,γ_n)|∏_{j=2}^n|z_{γ_j}| is well-defined and satisfies R_γ≤exp(a_γ).
